confirmed_strengths: The cover and first chapter lead with the investable conclusion, current prices, targets, downside/upside and monitoring behavior.
The roadmap/physical-system distinction and 256 TB address-space boundary are visually prominent.
Both valuation matrices remain readable across the page break and expose method, weights, catalysts and invalidation.
The reader-facing per-ticker sentiment bridge exposes embedded growth, forecast growth, gap, event-day move, liquidity proxy and price-to-fundamental-base premium/discount for all 12 modeled issuers.
The three-dimensional company reconciliation separates Atlas relationship evidence, broader-business valuation eligibility and research action for all 12 modeled issuers.
The primary current-share P/E and independent business-specific forward P/S methods are disclosed separately; PEG is retained only as a zero-weight expectation diagnostic.
The disclaimer distinguishes AStock model targets from external broker ratings and states that the report is not a securities recommendation.
required_next_fixes: Create final governance artifacts and rerun the case-local verifier to 39 PASS / 0 FAIL.
